title: Filesystem tests use a per-test GUID temp directory, cleaned up in finally
statement: A test that writes to the filesystem creates its own directory under `Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), "<suite>-tests", Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N"))`, does its work inside a `try`, and deletes that directory in a `finally`. Tests do not write to a fixed repository-relative path.
rationale: xUnit runs test classes in parallel by default; a fixed path shared by two tests is a race, and a test that throws before cleanup leaves permanent litter in the repo or temp directory. The GUID-per-test pattern already used in `GuidelineImpactAnalyzerTests` makes every test's filesystem footprint disjoint and self-cleaning even on failure.

good.caption: Isolated, GUID-suffixed temp root with guaranteed cleanup.

bad.caption: Fixed relative path, shared across runs, never cleaned up.

changelog.summary: Initial rule, grounded in GuidelineImpactAnalyzerTests.cs's temp-directory lifecycle.
